moana.name: Ace Runs - Moana (Kiwi cartoon heroine)
moana.source: Voice Design (POST /v1/text-to-voice/design, model eleven_ttv_v3, guidance_scale 5, should_enhance false), preview B_1 saved with POST /v1/text-to-voice
moana.voice_description: Very high-pitched, sparkly and squeaky-bright youthful cartoon heroine voice for an animated kids show, with a strong New Zealand accent. Bubbly, upbeat, encouraging and full of giggles, light airy tone, clean studio recording.
moana.preview_text: Kia ora! Sweet as, let's go for a run, eh? Ooh, yum, a crunchy carrot! Ka pai! Chur, that was heaps good fun! Choice, let's have another go!

selection.scribe_transcript: Kia ora. Sweet as. Let's go for a run, eh? Ooh, yum, a crunchy carrot. Ka pai. Cheer, that was heaps good fun. Choice, let's have another go
selection.why: Highest median F0 tier (381 Hz vs Ace 333 Hz) with the widest upper range (p75 457 Hz), and one of only a few previews where Scribe heard both 'Kia ora' and 'Ka pai' correctly; lower English-language confidence than most previews is a proxy for a stronger Kiwi accent.
selection.refusals: Voice Design returned 403 blocked_generation for every request whose preview text contained the name 'Moana' and for one description mentioning a 'small and light voice'; the accepted requests used a preview line without the name.
